Build me a sprawling, weathered chemical-processing complex in a flat, pale, semi-arid landscape, brightly sunlit yet overgrown and slightly abandoned in mood. Arrange a dense central cluster of tall refinery towers, cylindrical reactors, furnaces, ducts, scaffolding, and red-and-white banded smokestacks, divided by a loose grid of broad concrete service roads and narrow rail tracks. Surround this core with roughly a dozen low corrugated-metal industrial halls, sheds, and utility buildings, all faded gray and facing internal yards or streets. Place several huge round storage tanks along one outer side, groups of white spherical gas tanks at opposite corners, and long pipe racks, elevated conveyors, catwalks, cooling units, transformers, pallets, stacked pipes, sacks, and small equipment throughout. Keep the machinery tightly packed and vertically layered near the center, with more open loading yards and utility plots toward the edges. Use cracked concrete, dusty gravel, puddles, weeds, shrubs, and mature trees between structures. Enclose the site loosely with walls and fencing, beyond which scrubland, winding water channels, curving roads, and a bridge define the scene’s irregular perimeter.

=== THE TASK ===
Rebuild the place described above on the 200 m x 200 m plate, at the density
and arrangement the description calls for. Budget is 800 tool calls and 180
minutes — you are not expected to use all of it, but clean collision and
floating numbers are not on their own evidence that the scene is finished.
Take screenshots, look at them, and judge the result against the description.

clauses.text: Build me a sprawling, weathered chemical-processing complex in a flat, pale, semi-arid landscape, brightly sunlit yet overgrown and slightly abandoned in mood

Arrange a dense central cluster of tall refinery towers, cylindrical reactors, furnaces, ducts, scaffolding, and red-and-white banded smokestacks, divided by a loose grid of broad concrete service roads and narrow rail tracks
Surround this core with roughly a dozen low corrugated-metal industrial halls, sheds, and utility buildings, all faded gray and facing internal yards or streets

Place several huge round storage tanks along one outer side, groups of white spherical gas tanks at opposite corners, and long pipe racks, elevated conveyors, catwalks, cooling units, transformers, pallets, stacked pipes, sacks, and small equipment throughout
Keep the machinery tightly packed and vertically layered near the center, with more open loading yards and utility plots toward the edges
Use cracked concrete, dusty gravel, puddles, weeds, shrubs, and mature trees between structures
Enclose the site loosely with walls and fencing, beyond which scrubland, winding water channels, curving roads, and a bridge define the scene’s irregular perimeter
